description: LDP Montgomery Canal is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Powys County Council. This dataset shows Montgomery Canal shown in the Adopted Powys LDP (2011 - 2026) The Powys Local Development Plan (2011-2026) was adopted by Powys County Council on the 17th of April 2018 and became operative immediately. It is applicable to all of Powys except the area of the Brecon Beacons National Park. Coverage: Powys County Council. The portal files it under the publisher Powys County Council. It offers 3 resource(s) in OGC WMS, PNG, SHP / ZIP. The portal shows 2022-04-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
